svg.title: Pediatric neck mass decision chart: congenital masses are most likely and location decides between a midline thyroglossal duct cyst, a lateral second branchial cleft cyst and a posterior-triangle lymphatic malformation; an enlarged node over 2 cm is worked up for infection or malignancy; each column gives clues, investigations and treatment
